overview.purpose: See what needs attention, run the next coaching step, and leave with one clear commitment.

creators.purpose: Scan every creator, address due work, and open the right workspace without hunting across the app.

setup.purpose: Define the audience, message, offer, and operating constraints once, then update them only when strategy changes.

plan.purpose: Choose the month’s priorities and Reach, Trust, and Convert mix before planning individual videos.

results.purpose: Open this when a review is due, then turn performance evidence into one future decision.
